name: Deployment pipelines Fabric APIs Phase II
description: In line with Fabric alignment, we are finalizing the public APIs for the Deployment pipelines on the Fabric platform, following the initial batch of APIs released in May 2024. While the May release provided the ability to retrieve existing deployment pipeline details and stages, the upcoming release will introduce APIs for their modification, workspace addition/removal, access control, and administrative tasks.
